attestation.notes_en: Microtasks 182 syna_pm_suspend, 183 syna_pm_resume, 184 syna_cdev_create, 185 syna_cdev_devnode, 186 syna_cdev_remove, 188 syna_cdev_read, and 189 syna_cdev_write were locally attested with two byte-identical canonical builds each, exact Assembly and relocation comparison, matching KCFI, strict Joern, and two-cycle ASan/UBSan harnesses. Task 186 matches the stock 400-byte/100-instruction function and KCFI type ID 0x3175607e; its direct-source harness covers null-TCM logging, full valid teardown, an empty no-managed-device path, and character-device teardown. Task 188 matches the stock 160-byte/40-instruction function and KCFI type ID 0xf4e9d97c; its direct-source harness covers the zero-length path, full read, partial-read diagnostic, and negative 32-bit return with request truncation. Task 189 matches the stock 160-byte/40-instruction function and KCFI type ID 0xc3d43b4d; its direct-source harness covers the equivalent zero-length, full-write, partial-write diagnostic, and negative-return paths. For both cdev transfer functions, bounded assembly equivalences prove u32 argument setup, the signed printk argument path, and the post-indexed g_cdev_data mutex address against raw stock relocations. A source-sync gate pins the builder source tree before canonical builds. No smartphone, module load, or hardware validation was performed. The full driver remains incomplete.
attestation.notes_pt: As microtarefas 182 syna_pm_suspend, 183 syna_pm_resume, 184 syna_cdev_create, 185 syna_cdev_devnode, 186 syna_cdev_remove, 188 syna_cdev_read e 189 syna_cdev_write foram atestadas localmente com dois builds canonicos byte-a-byte identicos cada, comparacao exata de Assembly e relocacoes, KCFI correspondente, Joern estrito e harnesses ASan/UBSan em dois ciclos. A tarefa 186 corresponde a funcao stock de 400 bytes/100 instrucoes e ao ID de tipo KCFI 0x3175607e; seu harness direto no fonte cobre log de TCM nulo, teardown valido completo, caminho vazio sem dispositivo gerenciado e teardown do dispositivo de caracteres. A tarefa 188 corresponde a funcao stock de 160 bytes/40 instrucoes e ao ID de tipo KCFI 0xf4e9d97c; seu harness direto no fonte cobre caminho de tamanho zero, leitura completa, diagnostico de leitura parcial e retorno negativo de 32 bits com truncamento da requisicao. A tarefa 189 corresponde a funcao stock de 160 bytes/40 instrucoes e ao ID de tipo KCFI 0xc3d43b4d; seu harness direto no fonte cobre os caminhos equivalentes de tamanho zero, escrita completa, diagnostico de escrita parcial e retorno negativo. Para as duas funcoes de transferencia cdev, equivalencias limitadas de Assembly provam a preparacao de argumento u32, o caminho de argumento assinado para printk e o endereco do mutex g_cdev_data pos-indexado contra relocacoes stock brutas. Um portao de sincronizacao fixa a arvore de fontes do compilador antes dos builds canonicos. Nenhum smartphone, carregamento de modulo ou validacao em hardware foi executado. O driver completo permanece incompleto.
